latest.title: Challenges in Cloud Data Processing: What Happens When Data Gets Bigger?
latest.description: Explore the major challenges of processing large datasets in cloud environments, including network latency, performance, scalability, infrastructure costs, data quality, security, and monitoring. This article discusses practical approaches using AWS services such as Amazon S3, EC2, Glue, EMR, Athena, and CloudWatch to build efficient and reliable data-processing pipelines.

latest.title: AWS Multipath Resilience: Rethinking Failover for Mission-Critical Traffic
latest.description: AWS is taking a different approach to network failover by sending duplicate packets across physically independent paths instead of waiting for a failed route to recover. Developed alongside Stripe, Multipath Resilience could change how financial platforms and other latency-sensitive applications approach multi-Region networking.

latest.title: Secure Multi-Agent Orchestration for Agentic AI on AWS: A Technical Guide
latest.description: Learn how to secure autonomous multi-agent systems using trust boundaries, cryptographic message signing, and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime. This guide explores practical architectures to prevent compromised agents from spreading laterally across your network.

latest.title: Stopping Hidden AWS EC2 T4g Surplus CPU Credit Charges: Unlimited vs Standard vs C6g
latest.description: A real-world Cost Explorer breakdown showing why burstable Graviton t4g.micro instances silently add $0.62/day in surplus CPU fees under 24/7 workloads, and how to pick between Standard mode, t4g.small, and c6g.medium.

latest.title: 不让你破产的 agent:AWS 上的 agent 系统成本控制
latest.description: agent 消耗的 token 远多于普通对话,所以成本必须在第一次运行之前就设计进去。本文给出一个"三个时刻"框架(启动之前、使用期间、持续进行),每个时刻都分为系统侧和人员侧。最后用我们内部的 BOM agent COBRA 做一个实例:一份典型估算的运行成本约为 0.05 美元,每月剩余成本中约 87% 来自架构师的复核。

latest.title: Distributed Locks on Amazon S3 Without a Database
latest.description: Build a zero-database distributed lock manager using Amazon S3 conditional writes (If-None-Match and If-Match) for serverless leader election and state safety.

latest.title: AI Agents Are Getting Smarter, But Are We Making Them Secure?
latest.description: Explore the growing security challenges of AI agents, including prompt injection, excessive permissions, and sensitive data exposure. Discover why security must be a priority when building intelligent AI applications and how developers can create safer, more trustworthy AI systems.

latest.title: How Amazon Web Services Powers the Modern Cloud
latest.description: In today’s digital world, almost every app we use, movie we stream, and website we visit relies on cloud computing. At the forefront of this revolution is Amazon Web Services (AWS), the world’s most comprehensive and widely adopted cloud platform. Launched by Amazon in 2006, AWS has transformed how businesses build, deploy, and scale their technology infrastructure.

trending.title: When a flood alert is issued, serve one small emergency page on every URL: CloudFront KeyValueStore, a template, and an AI agent kept off the critical path
trending.description: When a flood alert is issued, the city website is needed most and loads worst. This tutorial builds a disaster mode on AWS: every URL switches to one small emergency page at the edge with a CloudFront Function and KeyValueStore. A page built by code from the city's data goes live first; a Strands agent on Bedrock AgentCore can only replace it with a page that passes the same checks. Covers late and retried alerts, measured switch times, cost, and a full deploy, verify and teardown path.
